decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Arboricultural Impact Assessment Report, Design and Access Statement, 00373(00)00, 00373(00)01, 00373(00)02, 00373(00)03, 00373(00)04, 00373(00)05, 00373(00)06, 00373(00)07, 00373(00)08, 00373(00)09, 00373(00)10, 00373(00)11, 00373(00)12, 00373(00)13,  00373(00)14,  00373(00)15 Received: 18 December 2013 00373(01)01 Rev. B Received: 10 February 2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The extension and outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as [22 Wellesley Road, Chiswick W4 4BN].

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension,alteration to existing window fenestration on rear elevation. Roof extension to rear of the property. Remodelling of front garden wall to include larger opening, metal railings and pedestrian access. Addition of bicycle store to front driveway and a garden shed to the rear of the house
